details.description: Puramate Agar Agar is a pure, vegetable-based gelling agent that can be used as an alternative to animal gelatin. It is ideal for creating delicious fruit spreads, pie fillings, vegetable aspics, and other solid foods. This agar powder is particularly useful for baking, making vegan cheese, jellies, custards, and marshmallows, providing a cholesterol-free and chemical-free option. It is suitable for both sweet and savoury dishes that require a gelling agent, such as jellies, jams, desserts, and aspics. The gelling capacity depends on the acidity of the preparation, with acidic recipes requiring a bit more agar-agar. However, it should not be combined with chocolate or kiwi, as they can neutralise the gelling effect.

It is nontoxic & therefore very suitable for use in food formulation.
Benefits 
GMSgive cakes of good volume. 
Improve bread texture, and retard staling
Improve aeration of doughs

Used as an emulsifier in the biscuits dough as it disperses fat uniformly

It is nutritious and filling and can be consumed as a quick meal at any time of the day. Skimmed Milk Powder is very versatile, both as a baking ingredient and all-round handy cooking aid. Use it to create frostings and puddings, chocolate and confectionery, cakes, tarts and desserts, battered and breaded products for flavour, adhesion and browning and a wide array of baked goods. It’s ideal for cooking & baking since it has a much longer shelf life than liquid milk.
Good solubility
Rich, creamy flavour 
Good flow properties 
Whole milk powder is great for use in confections, baked goods, or as a nutrient supplement 
Also great for use as an ingredient in dry blends or reconstituted for use as liquid milk
details.ingredients: Skimmed Milk Solids
details.usageInstructions: To reconstitute add 5 parts of water to one part of skimmed milk powder.

Puramate Whole Milk Powder possesses all the appealing qualities of milk and, in its dry form, is an important ingredient in the manufacture of a remarkable range of food products.  It has a particularly wide range of applications in the confectionery industry, namely for chocolate, toffee and caramel confections, modern ice cream, milk beverages, toppings and icings, recipe dishes, infant formula, breakfast cereals, soups and sauces, and coffee whiteners.
